site_name: Initiative for Legal Aid South Sudan
tagline: Empowering Access To Justice In South Sudan
hero_eyebrow: Legal support for communities in need
about_story: The Initiative for Legal Aid was established to ensure that justice is accessible to all South Sudanese citizens, aligning legal aid with the empowerment of communities.

values.title: Justice And Equality
values.text: We believe in equal rights and opportunities for all.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We act with honesty, transparency, and accountability.

values.title: Service
values.text: We stand with vulnerable communities and respond with dignity.

mission: We work to protect rights, promote legal awareness, and support vulnerable people through justice-focused advocacy and practical legal assistance.
mission_title: Justice should be within reach for every person.
mission_text: We work with vulnerable communities to improve access to legal information, practical support, and rights-based advocacy that promotes dignity, safety, and long-term resilience.

mission_cards.title: Legal Awareness
mission_cards.text: Helping people understand their rights and the legal tools available to them.

mission_cards.title: Advocacy
mission_cards.text: Championing the voices of those often left out of formal justice systems.

mission_cards.title: Community Support
mission_cards.text: Building stronger local responses through dialogue, mediation, and outreach.

services.title: Access to Justice & Legal Aid
services.text: Accessible, affordable, timely and high-quality legal services for individuals and communities who would otherwise be unable to protect or enforce their rights.

services.title: Human Rights Protection
services.text: Preventing human rights violations, supporting victims, strengthening accountability mechanisms and encouraging compliance with national and international standards.

services.title: Women & Children's Rights
services.text: Advancing gender equality and ensuring that women, girls, boys and vulnerable children enjoy their legal rights and protection.

services.title: Peacebuilding & Social Cohesion
services.text: Supporting peaceful coexistence by addressing the underlying causes of conflict while strengthening community resilience and social harmony.

services.title: Governance & Rule of Law
services.text: Promoting constitutionalism, transparency, accountability, citizen participation and institutional integrity while supporting justice sector reform.

services.title: Civic & Legal Education
services.text: Increasing legal literacy so that citizens can exercise and defend their rights, participate in governance and resolve disputes peacefully.

services.title: Research, Policy & Advocacy
services.text: Generating evidence that informs public debate, strengthens legislation, improves governance and supports evidence-based advocacy.

services.title: Institutional Capacity Development
services.text: Strengthening the organizational, technical, governance and leadership capacities of institutions involved in justice delivery and community development.

projects.title: Legal Empowerment Workshops
projects.text: These workshops equip individuals with essential legal knowledge to advocate effectively for their rights.

projects.title: Community Dialogues
projects.text: Facilitated discussions that aim to resolve conflicts peacefully and strengthen community bonds.

projects.title: Advocacy Campaigns
projects.text: Targeted campaigns raising awareness about human rights issues affecting local communities.

projects.title: Research Projects
projects.text: In-depth studies that inform our strategies and response to legal challenges in South Sudan.

who_we_are_title: An independent national organisation for justice in South Sudan
who_we_are_p1: The Initiative for Legal Aid (ILA) is an independent national civil society organization established to promote access to justice, protect and advance human rights, strengthen the rule of law, and contribute to good governance, peacebuilding, and sustainable development in the Republic of South Sudan.
who_we_are_p2: ILA serves as both a legal service provider and a development organization by combining legal aid, human rights advocacy, civic education, research, institutional development, policy engagement, peacebuilding, and community empowerment within an integrated programming framework.
challenge_title: Justice remains out of reach for many South Sudanese
challenge_text: Women, children, persons with disabilities, displaced people, detainees and low-income households face legal, financial, geographical and institutional barriers to justice. ILA was established as a response to these realities.
challenge_quote: Justice is not a privilege reserved for those with financial means or social influence, but a universal and fundamental human right guaranteed to every individual without discrimination.
services_intro: ILA combines direct legal assistance with advocacy, research, institutional strengthening, civic education, peacebuilding and community engagement — addressing both immediate legal needs and the structural causes of injustice.

flagship.title: Access to Justice & Legal Aid
flagship.text: The Access to Justice and Legal Aid Programme seeks to bridge this gap by providing accessible, affordable, timely, and high-quality legal services to individuals and communities who would otherwise be unable to protect or enforce their rights.
